notes.title: Progress update 7
notes.notes:
This update adds several quality of life improvements along with other changes

Increased the max zoom out for the map camera

Added scaling for building UI

Updated troop allocation UI to support moving units on mass

You can now drag and move units around in all of the army UIs

Villages can now be upgraded to get a medium build slot

Village buildings are now destroyable 

Added more feedback to the next move position during battle deployment along with allowing units to be rotated during it

Stopped routing units from getting a extra move action during first route

Added morale debuffs; under range fire and losing in combat

Rebalanced morale to make it easier to keep enemy units routed 

Fixed units switching spots in auto battle

Added buildings Manor and War Workshop for the Medlend faction meaning Foot knights and Catapults are now recruitable

Rebalanced unit costs

Bug fixes

Follow and Wishlist!

notes.title: Progress update 6
notes.notes:
All Units now have a morale stat that determines how much stress they can take before routing. A battle is won or lost based on if all units in an army are routing meaning you no longer have to kill every model within a unit to win a battle.

What determines whether unit is going to route is based off of how much health they lost along with the situation they are in such as surrounded and enemy traits such as intimidate.
